name: Aletheia-Mixed-DPO
description: Aletheia-Mixed-DPO is a dataset of preference/response pairs intended for training and evaluating preference-optimization (DPO) style instruction-following models. It measures a model's alignment with human preferences across mixed task types and safety-sensitive prompts, supporting evaluation of preference ranking and instruction quality. The benchmark is used to compare models' win-rates and preference accuracy under DPO-style fine-tuning.
reputation: Moderately used by alignment and RLHF researchers as a mixed preference dataset for experimenting with DPO-style training.
